In detail

A quiet Buda-side district known for its historic wine cellars and mostly residential character. A July 2025 crime-hotspot map named Districts I, II, XII, XVI and XXII together as showing significantly lower crime rates than the rest of the city, and District XXII does not appear in any burglary, violent-crime, or nightlife-disorder hotspot list checked for this build. Sources checked: Metropol.hu, 20 Jul 2025 (30-day crime-hotspot map).
